title: How Rachael Kirkconnell Is Styling The Bouncy Tee This Fall
summary: The new UA Bouncy Tee for women combines a clean, flattering fit with the performance technology Under Armour is known for. Bounces back after wearing it all weekend, moisture-wicking, and pit stain resistance.
body_markdown:
#### **Some decisions require a second thought. Your T-shirt shouldn't be one of them.**


Earlier this year, Under Armour built on its legacy as the originator of the performance tee with the launch of The UA Bouncy Tee, raising the standard for what an everyday shirt can do. Now, just in time for fall, the fan-favorite silhouette is available in a women's-specific fit designed to move with her through every part of the day.


The new UA Bouncy Tee for women combines a clean, flattering fit with the performance technology Under Armour is known for. Made with a premium blend of Pima cotton and NEOLAST™, it stretches, recovers and holds its shape wear after wear. Moisture-wicking technology helps keep you dry, whether you're headed to a workout, meeting friends for brunch or simply tackling a packed day.


Comfortable enough for a rest day, polished enough for plans, and versatile enough for everything in between, The UA Bouncy Tee is built to go wherever fall takes you. It's already become a staple in Rachael Kirkconnell's rotation. See how she's styling it this season.
